mainProgress: 本期共收录 24 篇，研究重心集中在几何拓扑、低维流形与结（8 篇）、黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构（5 篇）、度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间（4 篇）。
技术路径以胞腔模型与受阻粘合、闭测地线等分布、不定 cobordism 不等式、超平面排列与自适应覆盖为主；进展形态主要是不可计算性定理（1 篇）、等周下界改进与采样应用（1 篇）。

breakthroughPoints.title: The Twist Conjecture and the Isomorphism Problem for Coxeter groups
breakthroughPoints.summary: 以一般形式解决 Mühlherr 的 Twist 猜想，完成长期 Coxeter 群同构判定计划的重要最后一步；同时产生自同构群的有效有限生成结论。

breakthroughPoints.title: Instantons, indefinite 4-manifolds, and Dehn surgery
breakthroughPoints.summary: 从此前未有整数同调球手术数超过 2 的已知例子，提升为显式任意大族，回答 Auckly/Kirby 问题中的重要部分；同时计算 Poincaré 同调球连通和的手术数。

breakthroughPoints.title: Realising atomless laws as distance distributions on metric measure spaces
breakthroughPoints.summary: 解决 Aldous–Blanc–Curien 对绝对连续距离分布的猜想，并覆盖奇异无原子测度；克服直观超度量模型不可分的障碍。

cautions: 其中 7 篇仅完成摘要级分析；技术细节、定理假设和适用范围需回查正文。
《The Twist Conjecture and the Isomorphism Problem for Coxeter groups》：同构问题推论使用 Howlett–Mühlherr 与 Marquis–Mühlherr 的既有化约，不能归为本文孤立证明。给出有限算法不表示有实用复杂度界；本次核读主定理与证明总纲，不是对 48 页证明的独立认证。
《Instantons, indefinite 4-manifolds, and Dehn surgery》：核心 cobordism 不等式要求第一整系数同调无 2-挠；不应将引言定理中的 F2-同调球范围无条件推广。67 页技术证明本次核对引言、主定理及证明架构，未逐行复核粘合分析。

reports.title: The Twist Conjecture and the Isomorphism Problem for Coxeter groups
reports.abstract: We prove Mühlherr's Twist Conjecture: any two angle-compatible Coxeter generating sets of a Coxeter group differ by a finite sequence of elementary twists and a conjugation. Combined with earlier work of Howlett-Mühlherr and Marquis-Mühlherr, this completes the resolution of the Isomorphism Problem for Coxeter groups. A further consequence is that ${\rm Aut}(W)$ is finitely generated for every Coxeter group $W$, and there is an algorithm producing a finite set of generators for ${\rm Aut}(W)$ starting from any Coxeter matrix. Of the vast literature on the Twist Conjecture, we utilise only two results in an essential way: strong rigidity of $2$--spherical Coxeter systems, due to Caprace and Mühlherr, and the framework of markings and hierarchies developed by Caprace and Przytycki for the twist-rigid case. We also exploit in a fundamental way some soft ideas from JSJ theory and an observation of Mihalik-Tschantz on splittings of Coxeter groups. No form of AI was used in the writing of this manuscript, nor in the research that it presents.

techniques: 兼容子集的 shrub 分解

reports.breakthrough: 以一般形式解决 Mühlherr 的 Twist 猜想，完成长期 Coxeter 群同构判定计划的重要最后一步；同时产生自同构群的有效有限生成结论。

reports.title: Instantons, indefinite 4-manifolds, and Dehn surgery
reports.abstract: We prove that there exist hyperbolic integer homology spheres with arbitrarily large Dehn surgery number. Previously, no integer homology sphere was known to have a surgery number larger than $2$. Our approach uses Froyshov's invariant $q_3$ of integer homology spheres, which is defined in terms of mod 2 instanton homology. We show that if $W: Y \to Y'$ is a cobordism between integer homology spheres with no $2$-torsion in its first homology, then $-b^+(W) \le q_3(Y') - q_3(Y) \le b^-(W)$. We also extend both $q_3$ and the inequality to rational homology spheres.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: Dehn 手术复杂度突破
reports.workSummary: 构造 Dehn 手术数可任意大的双曲整数同调球，并对显式族给出手术数的精确值。关键是以模 2 instanton 同调中的 Frøyshov q3 不变量控制不定四维 cobordism 的正、负 Betti 数。
reports.breakthrough: 从此前未有整数同调球手术数超过 2 的已知例子，提升为显式任意大族，回答 Auckly/Kirby 问题中的重要部分；同时计算 Poincaré 同调球连通和的手术数。
reports.limitations: 核心 cobordism 不等式要求第一整系数同调无 2-挠；不应将引言定理中的 F2-同调球范围无条件推广。67 页技术证明本次核对引言、主定理及证明架构，未逐行复核粘合分析。
reports.priorityReason: 直接突破经典低维拓扑复杂度问题，结果跨度大且带显式构造，q3 的新不等式另具工具价值；列为当日最优先精读之一。

reports.title: Realising atomless laws as distance distributions on metric measure spaces
reports.abstract: We study which probability measures on $[0,\infty)$ can occur as the distribution of the distance between two independent points sampled from a complete separable metric space equipped with a Borel probability measure. We prove that an atomless Borel probability measure can be realised in this way if and only if its support contains the origin. This settles the conjecture of Aldous, Blanc, and Curien for absolutely continuous laws and also covers atomless measures that are singular with respect to Lebesgue measure. Moreover, for every $L>1$, we show that the realising metric may be chosen $L$-bi-Lipschitz equivalent to an ultrametric. The proof constructs the space from compact components whose mutual distances produce prescribed parts of the measure, while distances within the components are assigned to smaller scales.
reports.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
reports.progressType: 距离分布实现问题的完整刻画
reports.workSummary: 证明 [0,∞) 上无原子的 Borel 概率测度可实现为完备可分度量概率空间内两独立采样点的距离分布，当且仅当其支撑含 0；实现度量还可对任意 L>1 取为与某超度量 L-bi-Lipschitz 等价。
reports.breakthrough: 解决 Aldous–Blanc–Curien 对绝对连续距离分布的猜想，并覆盖奇异无原子测度；克服直观超度量模型不可分的障碍。
reports.limitations: 结论仅刻画两点距离的单一边缘分布，不决定整个度量测度空间；含原子一般分布和三点联合距离分布不能据此一并解决。近超度量不等于可分超度量本身。
reports.priorityReason: 基础逆问题获得简洁充要条件，构造方法对度量概率模型有广泛启发；限制清晰且结果超出原猜想范围，列为度量测度方向首读。

reports.title: Mean curvatures and symmetry of convex hypersurfaces
reports.abstract: Let $M^n$ be a $C^2$ closed convex hypersurface in Euclidean space, and $σ_m$ be its $m$th mean curvature. We show that $M$ is symmetric with respect to a hyperplane orthogonal to a given direction $e$, if $σ_m(p)\leqσ_m(q)$ whenever $p-q$ is parallel to $e$. For convex hypersurfaces, this settles a conjecture of Li, extends the mean-curvature theorem of Li-Yan-Yao to all $σ_m$, and strengthens some earlier results of Li-Nirenberg by removing nondegeneracy assumptions. The proof is based on the theory of mixed volumes, specifically the rigidity of quermassintegrals under Steiner symmetrization.
reports.topic: 曲率与比较几何
reports.progressType: 凸超曲面对称性定理
reports.workSummary: 对 Euclidean 空间中 C² 闭凸超曲面，若某一阶平均曲率沿指定方向的内部弦满足有向比较条件，则证明曲面关于垂直于该方向的超平面对称；允许非严格凸及高阶曲率退化。
reports.breakthrough: 在凸情形解决 Li 的对称性猜想，将平均曲率结果推广至全部 σm，并去除较早结论中的解析性或非退化要求；变分路线区别于反射和 Hopf 引理方法。
reports.limitations: 结论保留凸性及沿内部弦的方向性曲率条件，不是一般非凸闭超曲面的猜想解决；仅核读主定理、变分归约与等号刚性结构。
reports.priorityReason: 曲率几何相关性直接，条件削弱明确且证明由混合体积提供可迁移思路；篇幅紧凑，适合优先组会讨论。

reports.title: Trisection invariants of 4-manifolds are uncomputable
reports.abstract: We prove that two invariants of smooth 4-manifolds defined in terms of trisections are uncomputable: the trisection genus and the Kirby-Thompson L-invariant. That is, there does not exist an algorithm that takes as input a triangulated closed orientable 4-manifold and outputs one of these quantities. The result on the L-invariant resolves the second part of Problem 4.116 in the K3 problem list. In the same spirit, we show that the PL multisection genus of PL manifolds is uncomputable in dimensions at least four.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: 不可计算性定理
reports.workSummary: 证明输入闭、连通、可定向四维流形的 PL 三角剖分时，三分解亏格与 Kirby–Thompson L 不变量不存在通用精确计算算法；并将 PL 多分解亏格的不可计算性扩展至所有维数 n≥4。
reports.breakthrough: 为流形分解复杂度建立原则性算法障碍，回答 K3 问题表 4.116 的第二部分；结论不是算法慢，而是不存在对所有输入终止的精确算法。
reports.limitations: 并不排除特定流形类或给定分解的有效算法。给定三分解的 cut complex 距离是否可计算仍未解决；高维结论使用 PL 类别及有限三角剖分输入。
reports.priorityReason: 问题明确、证明路线紧凑且算法含义广，适合作为几何拓扑组会的高优先级短文；对实际计算项目的边界设定尤其重要。

reports.title: On 2-Sphere Bowditch Boundaries Attaining Conformal Dimension
reports.abstract: Bonk and Kleiner proved that if $G$ is a Gromov hyperbolic group whose boundary $\partial_{\infty}G$ is homeomorphic to an Ahlfors $Q$-regular metric $2$-sphere $Z$, and the Ahlfors regular conformal dimension of $Z$ is attained and equal to $Q$, then $G$ acts discretely, cocompactly, and isometrically on $\mathbb{H}^3$. In this article, we extend the Bonk-Kleiner theorem to the setting of relatively hyperbolic groups. More precisely, we prove that if $(G,\mathcal{H})$ is a relatively hyperbolic group whose Bowditch boundary is homeomorphic to an Ahlfors $Q$-regular metric $2$-sphere $Z$, with the Ahlfors regular conformal dimension of $Z$ attained and equal to $Q$, then $G$ acts discretely and isometrically on $\mathbb{H}^3$, and every subgroup in $\mathcal{H}$ is virtually $\mathbb Z^2$.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: 相对双曲群的边界统一化
reports.workSummary: 在 Bowditch 边界为 Ahlfors 正则二球且其 Ahlfors 正则共形维数可取到的条件下，将 Bonk–Kleiner 型结论推广至相对双曲群，得到离散双曲三空间等距作用和外围群 virtually Z²。
techniques: 成对点空间上的余紧性
reports.breakthrough: 通过一般紧度量空间上的 Loewner 判据，把边界维数达到极小值这一分析条件连接到相对双曲群的 Kleinian 几何实现。
reports.limitations: 共形维数可取到及正则性是关键前提，不能表述为无条件解决相对 Cannon 猜想。检查的是主定理与统一化推导，尚未独立复核全部模估计。
reports.priorityReason: 连接度量边界分析与三维双曲几何，结构性影响明显；因其接近重要猜想且依赖实质前提，值得相关专家优先核读。

reports.title: Torus actions, almost non-negative curvature and fundamental groups
reports.abstract: We prove conjectures due to Fukaya--Yamaguchi and Kapovitch--Petrunin--Tuschmann for fundamental groups of almost non-negatively curved closed manifolds under symmetry assumptions.
reports.topic: 曲率与比较几何
reports.progressType: 重要修订
reports.workSummary: 研究带环面作用的近非负曲率闭流形之基本群；修订版新增 Theorem 1.7，在低维最小闭轨道商条件下给出维数一致的虚二步幂零或虚阿贝尔结论。
reports.breakthrough: 新增定理把 Brue--Naber--Semola 的低维结果与环面作用方法结合，允许最小闭 stratum 的商维至多四，并给出只依赖总维数的指数界。
reports.limitations: 需要非负截面曲率、等距有效环面作用以及对最小闭 stratum 和 isotropy 的结构假设。

reports.revisionSummary: v2 新增 Theorem 1.7：在指定低维轨道商条件下，基本群含有维数一致有界指数的二步幂零子群；商维至多三时可取阿贝尔子群。

reports.title: The Sunada method on Metric Measure Spaces
reports.abstract: In this paper, we provide a general Sunada--Pesce--Sutton-type method that produces pairs of isospectral metric measure spaces. This construction relies on a representation theoretic assumption, and we give examples of spaces satisfying this condition, such as RCD spaces. As an application, we construct a pair of simply connected isospectral, non-isometric RCD non-Alexandrov spaces and a pair of Alexandrov non-orbifold spaces.
reports.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
reports.progressType: 非光滑同谱构造方法
reports.workSummary: 将 Sunada–Pesce–Sutton 方法推广至紧、测地、无穷小 Hilbert 且 Laplacian 具有紧预解式的度量测度空间，在群表示条件下得到商空间同谱；验证 RCD 情形并构造同谱非等距的奇异空间对。
techniques: Cheeger 能量及商空间 Laplacian
紧 Lie 群表示与 K-等价
主轨道类型与 RCD 特征函数正则性
reports.breakthrough: 允许从奇异底空间直接出发，构造单连通同谱的 RCD 非 Alexandrov 例子以及 Alexandrov 非 orbifold 例子，拓宽非光滑谱反问题的反例库。
reports.limitations: 一般定理要求紧性、无穷小 Hilbert 性、紧预解式、保测等距群作用及特征空间的表示条件；不是任意度量测度空间都可直接使用 Sunada 构造。
reports.priorityReason: 把经典谱几何方法有实质地迁入 RCD 与更一般奇异空间，兼具统一工具和鲜明例子，适合度量几何与谱理论读者优先阅读。

reports.title: Improved $\ell_0$-Isoperimetry for Convex Bodies via Mass Transport
reports.abstract: We study $\ell_0$ isoperimetry for a convex body $K\subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $n\ge2$. For a Borel set $S\subset K$, let $\partial_0^K S$ be the set of points in $K \setminus S$ that can be reached from $S$ by changing at most one coordinate (i.e. the $\ell_0$ boundary of $S$). Suppose that, for some unconditional convex body $Q \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, numbers $r,R>0$, and possibly different centers $x_0,y_0$, \[ x_0+rQ \subset K\subset y_0+RQ. \] Writing $s=\text{vol}(S)/\text{vol}(K)$, we prove that whenever $0<s \le 1/2$, \[ \frac{\text{vol}(\partial_0^K S)}{\text{vol}(S)} \ge \frac{cr}{nR} \min\left\{1,\frac{\log(e/s)}{n}\right\}, \] where $c > 0$ is an absolute constant. Consequently, the associated $\ell_0$-isoperimetric coefficient is at least $cr/(n^2R)$. Previous direct lower bounds were only known for $\ell_2$ and $\ell_\infty$ regularity whereas our lower bound holds directly for any $Q$-regularity, where $Q$ is an unconditional convex body. Compared to $\ell_2$ and $\ell_\infty$ regularity, our lower bound result improves upon the previously best known lower bounds, for any $s$, by a factor of $n$. As an application of our result, we give improved mixing time bounds for the Coordinate Hit and Run walk (CHAR). Our proof of the lower bound is based on a modification of the method of canonical paths applied to a continuous Hamming graph over our convex body. Our construction of canonical paths can be viewed as a suitable coordinate discretization of certain mass transport maps from $S$ to $S^c$. We also give complementary upper-bounds for any $Q$-regularity, with an overall factor of $n$ gap between the two.
reports.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
reports.progressType: 等周下界改进与采样应用
reports.workSummary: 对夹在两个可能不同中心的无条件凸体 Q 拷贝之间的凸体 K，证明坐标改变意义下的 ℓ0 边界扩张下界，并包含小集合的对数增益；由此改进 Coordinate Hit and Run 的混合时间控制。
techniques: 质量运输的坐标离散化
reports.breakthrough: 直接覆盖任意无条件 Q 的正则性，相比对应 Euclidean/立方体基准下界改进一个 n 因子；把运输结构转化成坐标局部移动的边界控制。
reports.limitations: 上下界仍有 n 因子缺口，作者也将进一步改进列为猜想。ℓ0 边界依赖坐标方向，任意仿射变换不保持该量；采样结论需区分初始化和正则性假设。
reports.priorityReason: 质量运输与凸几何方法可复用，并产生定量算法收益；但尚未达最优阶，且坐标依赖限制几何不变性，排在完整结构性解决之后。

reports.title: Entropy and domination for quasi-Hitchin representations
reports.abstract: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g\geq 2$. We consider an $n$-pleated representation $ρ: π_1(S) \to \mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ obtained by bending a Hitchin representation $ρ_0:π_1(S) \to \mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{R})$ along a maximal geodesic lamination. The space of such $n$-pleated representations was recently introduced by Maloni-Martone-Mazzoli-Zhang who provided a parametrization via shear-bend cocycles. Our first result is that $ρ_0$ dominates $ρ$ in the Hilbert length spectrum and the translation-length spectrum; this generalizes our earlier result for finite laminations on punctured surfaces. Using this, we prove entropy rigidity results: namely, the Hilbert entropy of a quasi-Hitchin representation in the bending fiber is strictly greater than that of $ρ_0$, and the same for the translation-length entropy in the case that $ρ_0$ is $n$-Fuchsian. The proof involves analyzing the weighted planar networks for finite approximants of the monodromy matrix, and establishing a strict domination for \emph{most} curves using the equidistribution of closed geodesics in the unit tangent bundle of $S$.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: 长度谱支配与熵刚性
reports.workSummary: 对闭曲面 Hitchin 表示沿极大测地层状集弯折得到的 n-pleated 复表示，证明原表示支配其 Hilbert 长度谱与平移长度谱；对保持 Borel–Anosov 的弯折得到 Hilbert 熵刚性。
reports.breakthrough: 把有限层状集和带穿孔曲面的支配方法推广至闭曲面的无限叶情形，并由多数曲线的严格支配导出弯折纤维中的熵严格性。
reports.limitations: 平移长度熵的刚性目前要求起始表示为 n-Fuchsian；对任意 Hitchin 表示的对应结论仍是作者期待。熵结论还要求弯折表示处于 quasi-Hitchin/Borel–Anosov 范围。
reports.priorityReason: 高阶 Teichmüller 理论相关性强，网络逼近与动力系统衔接有技术可迁移性；关键未完成范围清楚，适合相关方向优先精读。

reports.title: Discrepancy of geometric incidences
reports.abstract: We study the combinatorial (red-blue) discrepancy of finite point sets with respect to hyperplanes and, more generally, bounded-complexity affine algebraic sets. We prove that every $n$-point set in a real Euclidean space admits a red-blue coloring for which every affine algebraic set of dimension at most $D$ and degree at most $k$ has discrepancy at most $n^{\frac12-\frac{1}{2(D+1)}-\varepsilon}$ for some $\varepsilon=\varepsilon(D,k)>0$. This gives a polynomial improvement over the straightforward VC-dimension bound $\tilde O(n^{\frac12-\frac{1}{2(D+1)}})$. In the opposite direction, we construct $n$-point sets in $\mathbb R^d$ whose discrepancy with respect to hyperplanes is $\tildeΩ(n^{\frac12-\frac{1}{d+1}}),$ extending the point-line discrepancy lower bound of Chazelle and Lvov. We present further applications of our methods in communication complexity, concerning separation between randomized communication cost and deterministic communication cost with access to equality oracle.
reports.topic: 交叉方向与基础工具
reports.progressType: 几何 discrepancy 的多项式改进
reports.workSummary: 为实 Euclidean 空间有限点集相对有界维数、次数仿射代数集的红蓝 discrepancy 给出超过直接 VC 维数界的多项式改进，同时构造高维超平面 discrepancy 下界并给出通信复杂度应用。
reports.breakthrough: 利用实代数几何中 VC 维数未表达的结构，取得额外正指数 ε 的改进，并将平面点线下界拓展到高维超平面。
reports.limitations: 高维上下界尚未匹配，文中明确把缩小差距留作问题；ε 与维数及次数有关。结论针对代数集关联，不应泛化到所有半代数范围或半空间。
reports.priorityReason: 定量改进实质且技术跨组合、计算和几何，值得工具导向读者关注；对核心微分几何课题较间接，因此排在结构性几何突破之后。

reports.title: Laplace and Dolbeault operators on Sasakian manifolds
reports.abstract: Sasakian manifolds, the odd-dimensional analogues of Kähler manifolds, carry two natural pairs of first-order Dolbeault-type operators on the full complex of differential forms, extending the Kohn--Rossi differentials. On such Sasaki manifolds, we establish Kähler-type identities for these operators, and relate the resulting Dolbeault Laplacians to the Hodge Laplacian. Unlike the Kähler case, where $Δ=2Δ_{\overline\partial}$, the relation has extra terms coming from the Reeb flow. Using these formulas and a Lefschetz decomposition, we derive lower and upper eigenvalue estimates for $Δ$ on forms depending on the eigenvalues of the Lie derivative of the Reeb vector field.
reports.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
reports.progressType: 算子恒等式与谱估计
reports.workSummary: 在 Sasakian 流形的完整微分形式复形上研究两对 Dolbeault 型一阶算子，建立 Kähler 型恒等式，描述它们的 Laplacian 与 Hodge Laplacian 之间由 Reeb 流产生的修正项。
reports.breakthrough: 不局限于横向或基本形式，把 Sasakian 几何中的 Hodge 与 Dolbeault 谱联系提升到全形式层面，并导出依赖 Reeb 特征值的上下界。
reports.limitations: 已检查的是元数据与摘要；估计涉及 Reeb 流特征值，不能视为对所有 Sasakian 度量统一的无条件数值界。具体紧致性及谱分解假设仍需按正文使用。
reports.priorityReason: 特殊几何与谱理论相关性高，算子恒等式有迁移潜力；当前证据支持一套结构性工具，优先级低于当日已核验主定理的猜想解决与大范围推广。

reports.title: Hausdorff Dimension of the Set of Extreme Points of a Random Countable Stable Zonotope
reports.abstract: Let $d\geq 2$, $0<α<1$, and let $Γ_k$ be the successive arrival times of a standard Poisson process on $(0,\infty)$. Given independent uniform directions $\varepsilon_k\in S^{d-1}$, independent of $(Γ_k)$, we consider the random countable stable zonotope $Z_α=\bigoplus_{k=1}^{\infty}Γ_k^{-1/α}[0,\varepsilon_k]$. For its set of extreme points $\operatorname{ext} Z_α$, we prove that almost surely $\dim_H \operatorname{ext} Z_α=(d-1)α$, and that the critical Hausdorff measure $\mathcal H^{(d-1)α}(\operatorname{ext} Z_α)$ is almost surely finite. The lower bound follows from the tangential non-degeneracy of the stable increments of the parametrizing field and Frostman's energy criterion. For the upper bound we construct an adaptive covering: at each scale the Poisson jumps are split into large and small ones, the large jumps determine a finite hyperplane arrangement, and the sum of the small jumps controls the diameters of the images of its cells.
reports.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
reports.progressType: 随机凸体分形维数精确公式
reports.workSummary: 对 Poisson 跳跃长度和独立均匀方向生成的可数稳定 zonotope，证明其极点集的 Hausdorff 维数几乎处处等于 (d−1)α，并证明临界 Hausdorff 测度有限。
techniques: 超平面排列与自适应覆盖
reports.breakthrough: 用不同的上下界机制匹配得到随机极点集的精确维数，把稳定指数直接连接到凸体边界的分形复杂度。
reports.limitations: 限定 d≥2、0<α<1 及所述独立均匀方向模型；摘要只保证临界测度有限，不能推断其严格为正。本次未检查正文能量和覆盖估计细节。
reports.priorityReason: 精确维数结论和上下界技术清晰，适合随机几何/分形方向；模型专门且现有核查深度为摘要，综合排在普适度量测度问题之后。

reports.title: An Alexander Polynomial Refinement for Alternating Links, with Trapezoidal Properties
reports.abstract: We define an invariant of alternating links---a homogeneous, four-variable Laurent polynomial---that encodes the symmetrized Alexander polynomial, the signature, and other topological data. Along the way, we extend a spanning tree formulation of the Alexander polynomial due to Murasugi and Stoimenow from special alternating links to all alternating links. This project is motivated by Fox's trapezoidal conjecture; accordingly, we prove certain sequences associated to our invariant are trapezoidal for all alternating links. We also conjecture our polynomial has $M$-convex support, and that it satisfies symmetry and log-concavity properties. We prove a partial symmetry result.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: Alexander 多项式细化与梯形性
reports.workSummary: 为交替链环定义齐次四变量 Laurent 多项式，编码对称化 Alexander 多项式、signature 等信息；将原用于特殊交替链环的生成树表达推广到全部交替链环，并证明相关系数序列的梯形性。
techniques: 多变量 Laurent 不变量
reports.breakthrough: 以更细的不变量统一已有拓扑数据，为 Fox 梯形性问题提供新的组合结构与可检验猜想。
reports.limitations: 不能把关联序列的梯形性写成完整解决 Fox 猜想；M-凸支撑、全部对称性和对数凹性仍有猜想部分，仅证明部分对称性。本次核查摘要。
reports.priorityReason: 结不变量方向有明确新结构且与经典猜想衔接；尚有重要性质未证，适合作为中高优先级的专题阅读。

reports.title: A normal form for the Thin Flat Surfaces category
reports.abstract: The category TFS of thin flat surfaces, introduced by Khovanov, Qi, and Rozansky, is a strict symmetric monoidal category whose morphisms are compact oriented surfaces with corners arising as neighbourhoods of immersed graphs in a strip. We prove two main results. First, a normal form theorem: every connected viewable tf-cobordism is equal, in TFS, to a canonical composite determined by its topological type. Second, a sufficiency theorem: we establish a list of relations in the TFS category which are sufficient, meaning that any two composites of generators representing the same tf-cobordism are related by a finite sequence of the listed relations. Together, these results give a complete generators-and-relations presentation of TFS.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: 范畴正规形与完备表示
reports.workSummary: 为薄平坦曲面范畴 TFS 建立正规形：连通且可视的 tf-cobordism 可化为由拓扑型确定的标准复合；同时证明所列生成元关系足以联系表示同一 cobordism 的任意两个复合。
reports.breakthrough: 把正规形和关系充分性结合，给出 TFS 的完整生成元—关系表示，为相关拓扑范畴的计算提供明确基础。
reports.limitations: 结论针对 TFS 及其可视薄平坦曲面条件，不是任意曲面 cobordism 范畴的统一表示；本次仅核查摘要，未逐一核对 42 幅图中的关系。
reports.priorityReason: 完备关系表示对拓扑量子场论和范畴计算有明确工具价值，但对象较专门，先于一般例子论文、后于当日广泛影响的几何拓扑结果。

reports.title: Flows and Homotopies of Banach Lie algebroids
reports.abstract: We establish flow and homotopy tools for Banach Lie algebroids that do not rely on compactly supported extensions. Under suitable hypotheses, we construct parameter-dependent local extensions of sections along algebroid paths, complete lifts and their fibrewise-linear evolutions, and a Bochner-integral variation-of-constants formula. We then prove that an admissible-path homotopy is equivalently a Lie algebroid morphism from the parameter square and a solution of the associated transport equation. This provides the extension, transport and infinitesimal variation theory required for a local integration program of Banach Lie algebroids to be developed in a sequel.
reports.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
reports.progressType: 无限维局部流与同伦基础
reports.workSummary: 在 Banach Lie algebroid 上建立参数依赖的局部截面延拓、完全提升及纤维线性流、Bochner 积分变常公式，并证明可容许路径的同伦、参数方形上的 algebroid 态射与输运方程之间的等价性。
techniques: 完全提升及纤维线性演化
reports.breakthrough: 绕过一般 Banach 流形上缺少光滑 bump 函数和紧支延拓的问题，为无限维局部积分理论建立所需的无穷小工具。
reports.limitations: 参数统一延拓和同伦结论有联络及光滑仿紧性等条件；本文明确不构造积分的局部 Banach Lie groupoid，该工作留待后续。
reports.priorityReason: 填补无限维微分几何常用论证中的基础空缺，技术严谨性值得关注；目前定位是后续积分计划的工具层，应用范围专门。

reports.title: Semitoric systems with $2n$ Focus-Focus singularities
reports.abstract: In this paper, we provide new explicit examples of semitoric systems. More precisely, for any natural number $n$, we give a semtioric moment map $F_n$ with $2n$ focus-focus singularities defined on a symplectic manifold $(M_n,ω_n)$ of diffeomorphism type $\mathbb{CP}^2\sharp(2n+1)\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2$.
reports.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
reports.progressType: 显式可积系统构造
reports.workSummary: 对任意自然数 n，在 CP2 的 (2n+1) 次 blow-up 上显式构造具有 2n 个 focus-focus 奇点的 semitoric 系统。先由 2n+4 顶点的 Delzant 多面体构造环面系统，再用下降的复单项式实部组成新的动量映射。
reports.breakthrough: 把既有少量显式 focus-focus 示例扩展为任意偶数个奇点的可写公式族，而不只通过抽象局部模型粘合说明存在。
reports.limitations: 构造限定于指定 blow-up 拓扑型和偶数奇点族，不是所有 semitoric 系统的显式分类；本文分类不变量的全面计算并非摘要所述结果。
reports.priorityReason: 显式例子利于教学、奇点检验与后续量子化研究；相对普适结构定理更专门，辛几何方向可提高个人阅读优先级。

reports.title: The Saito determinant for extended affine Weyl discriminant strata
reports.abstract: We investigate the form of the Saito metric on quotients of the reflection representation of an extended affine Weyl group, restricted to an arbitrary stratum of its discriminant. We compute the Saito determinant for all strata and Dynkin types and show that it is divisible by a product of q-analogues of restricted roots for the associated hyperplane arrangement. Our results simultaneously generalise the factorisation in the Weyl denominator formula to higher codimension strata, and provide q-analogue refinements of results of Antoniou-Feigin-Strachan for Coxeter groups.
reports.topic: 交叉方向与基础工具
reports.progressType: 统一因子分解与显式计算
reports.workSummary: 计算扩张仿射 Weyl 群轨道空间中，文中所定义判别分层上的 Saito 度量行列式，给出所有 Dynkin 类型的三角型限制根因子分解。经典型由 Landau–Ginzburg 超势直接计算，例外型结合 Jacobian 子式与低维显式计算处理。
reports.breakthrough: 把 Weyl 分母型分解延伸到高余维分层，并给出有限 Coxeter 结果的 q-类比细化；扩张仿射情形的指数不再简单等同于 Coxeter 数。
reports.limitations: 分层采用文中的根超平面与抛物根子系统约定；不能不加辨别地推广至所有不共轭的仿射镜面交。部分例外型依赖附带 Wolfram notebook，本次未运行这些计算。
reports.priorityReason: 统一公式与可复用计算对 Frobenius 流形、可积系统有价值；但主要入口是表示论及专门分层计算，先排在直接解决几何核心问题的论文之后。

reports.title: Conditioning and interpolation error bounds for second-order Stiefel retractions with closed-form inverses
reports.abstract: Retractions provide a computationally efficient alternative to the Riemannian exponential and logarithm maps for practical data-processing tasks on manifolds. In particular, second-order retractions with closed-form inverse are well-suited for interpolation problems on manifolds. On the Stiefel manifold of orthogonal frames, there are only two retractions of this type: the Cayley retraction, which is second-order accurate under the canonical metric, and the recently proposed polar-light retraction, which is second-order accurate under the Euclidean metric. In this paper, we study the properties of these maps in the context of interpolation on the Stiefel manifold. To obtain explicit interpolation error bounds, we examine the conditioning of the retraction maps and their inverses. We show that the retractions are well-conditioned, and we derive interpolation error bounds similar to those of classical Euclidean interpolation. The inverse retractions are not well-conditioned in general, and we discuss how data can be mapped via an isometric group action to ensure stable computations. As with all retractions on compact manifolds, the inverse canonical Cayley retraction and the inverse polar-light retraction exist only locally, and we construct normal neighborhoods around any point in which either the inverse Cayley retraction or the invese polar-light retraction are guaranteed to be computable. As an application of the retraction maps, we consider Hermite interpolation, where the objective is to reproduce both sampled function values and derivative information. A numerical example demonstrates that retraction-based interpolation is competitive with classical methods based on Riemannian normal coordinates.
reports.topic: 交叉方向与基础工具
reports.progressType: 流形数值方法稳定性与误差界
reports.workSummary: 分析 Stiefel 流形上具有闭式逆的二阶 Cayley 与 polar-light retraction 的条件性，给出插值误差界、可保证逆可计算的局部邻域，并讨论利用等距群作用稳定逆映射计算。
reports.breakthrough: 为无需反复计算完整指数/对数映射的插值方案提供显式稳定性和误差保障，并把函数值与导数匹配的 Hermite 任务纳入框架。
reports.limitations: 逆 retraction 一般并不良态且只能局部存在；稳定化不等于获得全局逆。数值竞争性由文中的一个例子支持，不能扩展为普遍性能优势。
reports.priorityReason: 对流形数据处理与数值几何实用，误差可解释性好；重点是特定计算工具而非几何结构的新分类，按课题需求选择性阅读。

reports.title: Rigidity of closed $λ$-self-expanders
reports.abstract: A $λ$-self-expander $x: M^n\to \mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ is the solution of the isoperimetric problem of weight $e^{\frac{|x|^2}{4}}$. In this paper, we prove that the closed $λ$-self-expander is a round sphere centered at the origin under some curvature conditions. These curvature conditions mainly include the scalar curvature, the mean curvature, and the squared norm of the second fundamental form.
reports.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
reports.progressType: 加权自相似超曲面刚性
reports.workSummary: 对闭浸入 λ-self-expander，证明第二基本形式模平方恒定，或满足 R≥(n−2)H²/(n−1)>0 的标量曲率 pinching，均迫使其成为以原点为中心的圆球；当前 v2 PDF 的主定理已核对。
reports.breakthrough: 在闭浸入而不限于嵌入的范围，给出两个清晰的球面刚性充分条件，特别是只对第二基本形式模平方施加常量条件。
reports.limitations: 并非所有闭浸入 λ-self-expander 的无条件分类；需保留紧致与曲率假设。v2 引言已说明闭嵌入情形已有独立的 Alexandrov 型结论，因此本文价值主要在浸入与曲率条件。
reports.priorityReason: 曲率条件具体、加权算子技术可复用，适合自相似超曲面方向；范围与既有嵌入刚性结果应明确区分，综合优先级为中等。

reports.title: Equilibrium Laws for Julia's Zero and the Hyperbolic Zero of Binary Forms
reports.abstract: For a real binary form with no real roots, Julia's zero and the hyperbolic zero are two SL(2,R)-equivariant points in the upper half-plane. We show that they admit closely related equilibrium characterizations, with radial weights given respectively by the hyperbolic tangent and hyperbolic sine of the distances to the roots. This common framework gives geometric criteria for coincidence of the two zero maps. They always agree for binary quartics; for binary sextics they agree exactly when the three upper-half-plane roots form an equilateral hyperbolic triangle, or are collinear with one root the hyperbolic midpoint of the other two. We also obtain a corresponding result for collinear binary octics. The two equilibrium laws further reveal a sharp difference in the influence of distant roots. A strict majority of roots confined to a compact set keeps Julia's zero in a compact set, and the threshold one-half is optimal. In contrast, an escaping minority can force the hyperbolic zero to escape at linear scale. We also illustrate the computational advantages of the explicit formula for the hyperbolic zero.
reports.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
reports.progressType: 双曲平衡刻画与稳定性比较
reports.workSummary: 将无实根实二元型的 Julia 零点与双曲零点统一表述为上半平面中的加权平衡点，径向权重分别由双曲正切与双曲正弦给出；据此刻画若干低次数情形两零点重合的条件。
reports.breakthrough: 共同框架揭示两种中心对远处根影响的明显差异：Julia 零点具有严格多数根的紧性阈值，而双曲零点可被逃逸少数根拖走。
reports.limitations: 对象限定为无实根的实二元型；详细重合分类只覆盖文中四次、六次及特定共线八次情形，不是所有次数的完整分类。本次核查当前 v2 元数据与摘要。
reports.priorityReason: 双曲几何解释清楚，并有计算稳定性启发；应用集中在二元型约化及根配置，建议相关方向阅读，综合排序居中。

reports.title: A note on the positivity of $Q$-curvature via the continuity method
reports.abstract: Suppose $(M, g)$ is a smooth, closed, $5$-dimensional Riemannian manifold with positive Yamabe invariant $Y(M, [g]) > 0$ and positive Yamabe-type $Q$-curvature invariant $Y_{4}^{\ast}(M, [g]) > 0$. Using the continuity method, we prove the existence of a metric in the conformal class $[g]$ with positive scalar curvature and positive $Q$-curvature, assuming an additional condition on an ``initial metric" in the class $[g]$.
reports.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
reports.progressType: 附加条件下的连续性方法
reports.workSummary: 在正 Yamabe 不变量和正 Yamabe 型 Q 不变量的闭五维流形上，若初始共形度量满足文中 t0∈(1,10/3] 的点态正性条件，则通过连续性方法构造同时具有正标量曲率和正 Q 曲率的共形度量。
reports.breakthrough: 为五维边界情形提供一条连续性方法路线；价值在于方法补充而非首次无条件解决存在性，因为引言明确说明 Li 已用另一方法得到无附加条件结果。
reports.limitations: 必须保留初始度量及 t0 区间条件，不能仅凭两个全局正不变量援引本证明。作者指出移除额外条件可能需要新连续性路径。
reports.priorityReason: 对共形四阶 PDE 方法研究有意义，但适用条件较已有存在性结果更强；因此作为技术补充阅读，而非当日首要突破。

reports.title: Reduction of symmetric time-dependent Hamiltonian systems I: presymplectic principal $\mathbb{R}$-bundles
reports.abstract: The reduction of mechanical presymplectic structures and its application to the reduction of time-dependent Hamiltonian systems were developed in a recent paper (Gutiérrez Sagredo et al, 2025). This approach overcomes some limitations of the original Albert reduction (Albert, 1989). In this paper we will describe the reduction of time-dependent Hamiltonian systems using the extended formalism. This process combines cotangent bundle reduction with reduction of presymplectic structures of corank 1 and 2. These results generalize previous work (Lacirasella et al, 2012), in the same direction. Several examples will be presented to illustrate the theory from this new perspective.
reports.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
reports.progressType: Hamilton 系统约化框架推广
reports.workSummary: 以扩展形式论述具有对称性的含时 Hamilton 系统约化，结合余切丛约化与余秩 1、2 的预辛结构约化，在预辛主 R 丛框架中给出理论和例子。
techniques: 余秩 1 与 2 的预辛约化
含时 Hamilton 扩展形式
reports.breakthrough: 将已有含时机械系统约化工作纳入更一般的扩展形式，旨在处理原有 Albert 约化的部分限制。
reports.limitations: 当前检查 v2 的元数据与摘要；适用的对称性、正则性与约化存在条件需按正文逐项核对，不能视为任意退化 Hamilton 系统均可约化。
reports.priorityReason: 对几何力学与预辛结构研究有针对性工具价值；与本日报更广泛的曲率、度量及低维拓扑问题联系较间接，排序居中偏后。

reports.title: An example of biquandle and an invariant of long virtual knots defined through it
reports.abstract: We introduce an example of biquandle and define an invariant of long virtual knots through it. As an application, we give a necessary condition for two long virtual knots commuting.
reports.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
reports.progressType: 新不变量构造
reports.workSummary: 在具有非交换变量与次数完备化的整数系数环上定义 biquandle 结构，利用长虚结的着色构造不变量，并给出两个长虚结乘积可交换的必要条件。
reports.breakthrough: 提供一个能检测长虚结非交换乘法现象的具体代数工具，使虚结与经典结的差异可以由显式着色数据观察。
reports.limitations: 目前给出的是可交换性的必要条件，不是充要判据，也不是长虚结分类。只核对官方 PDF 引言和环/biquandle 构造页，尚未逐项重算后文图例。
reports.priorityReason: 对虚结着色与非交换不变量研究有针对性价值，但对本日报覆盖的曲率、分析和一般流形工具联系较少，综合阅读顺序靠后。
reports.lowPriorityReason: 主题集中于长虚结的专门代数着色，且应用是必要条件；课题组若没有虚结或 biquandle 项目，可先读当日适用面更广的拓扑结果。此为阅读排序，不是论文质量判断。
